the libvpx two-block dequantise, inverse-DCT and add shape (an `rbp` frame saving `xmm6`/`xmm7`): loads the 64 bytes at `[rcx]` as four 8-word rows and zeroes them, multiplies the rows at `+0` and `+0x20` by the words at `[rdx]` and those at `+0x10` and `+0x30` by `[rdx+0x10]` (`pmullw`), and runs two transposed butterfly passes whose odd terms are `x` + `pmulhw`(`x`, 0x8A8C) and `x` + `pmulhw`(`x`, 0x4E7B) (word tables `03001FD0`, `03001FE0`), the second pass adding 4 (`03001FC0`) and shifting each word right by 3 (arithmetic); then adds the rows to the four 8-byte rows at `r8` + `k` * the sign-extended `r9d` (`k` = 0..3), saturates them to unsigned bytes and stores them back; returns nothing

builds CPU feature flags `f` with `cpuid`: 0 when the maximum leaf is 0; else from leaf 1, `f` gains `0x1` for edx `0x800000`, `0x2` for edx `0x2000000`, `0x4` for edx `0x4000000`, `0x8` for ecx `0x1`, `0x10` for ecx `0x200` and `0x20` for ecx `0x80000`; when ecx has both of `0x18000000` and `xgetbv(0)` has both of `0x6` it gains `0x40`, and then, when the maximum leaf is at least 7 and leaf 7's ebx has `0x20`, `0x80`; finally stores to qword `02F974F8` `00133B40` when `f` has `0x10`, else `00179920`, and to qword `02F974F0` `00179360` when `f` has `0x80`, else `00179320`; returns nothing
